articles.headline: Will Lankshear scores brace as Middlesbrough come back to survive scare and beat Lincoln
articles.description: Marquee signing Will Lankshear notched a second-half double as Middlesbrough fought back to kick off their Championship bid with a hard-fought 2-1 victory and inflict a first defeat in eight and a half months on newly promoted Lincoln.

images.caption: Will Lankshear celebrates scoring the winning goal for Middlesbrough against Lincoln.

images.credit: Bruce Rollinson/PA Images via Getty Images

images.name: Will Lankshear [1296x729]
images.caption: Will Lankshear scored his first Championship goal for Middlesbrough to level the scores.

articles.headline: Raúl Jiménez marks Wolves return by rescuing draw with Blackburn

keyEvents.text: Goal! Portsmouth 1, Oxford United 0. Keshi Anderson (Portsmouth) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Colby Bishop.
Connor Ogilvie (Portsmouth) is shown the red card.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Jordan Williams replaces Conor Chaplin.
Substitution, Oxford United. Will Vaulks replaces Yunus Konak.
Substitution, Oxford United. Hidde ter Avest replaces Sam Long.
Second Half begins Portsmouth 1, Oxford United 0.
Goal! Portsmouth 1, Oxford United 1. Brodie Spencer (Oxford United) right footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the centre of the goal.
Brodie Spencer (Oxford United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Will Vaulks (Oxford United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Andre Dozzell (Portsmouth) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Marlon Pack (Portsmouth) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Oxford United. Przemyslaw Placheta replaces Brodie Spencer.
Michal Helik (Oxford United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Oxford United. Mark Harris replaces Myles Peart-Harris.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Millenic Alli replaces Keshi Anderson.
